title: Part One: The Question: Refusal or Front?

sections.brief: The central question stated plainly: the Holy See's public refusal of Zionism, Herzl 1904 to the Fundamental Agreement 1993, and the hypothesis that it was a front; the record at both ends; status as of October 2026; why the volume's other subjects belong. Figures: fig-time (headline dates 1904–2026)

The front hypothesis as framed in dv1_three_functions (linked, not repeated) turned into five tests fixed in advance: private record, money and favours, timing of shifts, treaty behaviour (Lateran Art. 24, FA Art. 11), cost of opposition; what will not count. Figures: fig-compare (front vs real-policy predictions)

Vocabulary (Holy See / Vatican City State / Catholic Church; Zionism / Israel / Judaism); documented, reported, disputed; living persons, abuse figures, stated positions; myths and labelled interpretation passages; map of the 19 parts. Figures: fig-compare (three subjects), fig-flow (route through the volume)
